title: They failed …
body: The application was clear and the basic functions were enough for me. However, after each launch of the application, a window popped up to purchase the paid version of the application, which was very annoying. However, after the last update, all the history of my habits was deleted ... tragedy, I'm deleting the application.
author: marthastamp

title: Good app, terrible customer support and policy
body: I’ve had this app for years because it’s simple and intuitive but their policies are too annoying. My premium finished, I got the notification there’s a sale, but when I tried to buy it, I got the price without the sale. I contacted them about it and no one responded so I decided not to buy premium. Today morning I go into my app and all my habits disappeared. If that the way they want me to buy premium (in which you can make offline copy of your habits) - that’s not the way. I had premium for a couple years, used this app for even more years and that’s there my tolerance ended.
author: agataj99

title: Everything disappeared
body: After a few years of using this app daily, all my habits disappeared today. The notification popped up in the evening as usual, but after tapping it the app is empty and invites me to create my first habit. I’ve been thinking about moving to another app for quite some time buty progress keeps me here. Well, I guess nothing is in the way now.

title: Good app, terrible policy / support
body: It's the only habit tracker that's not overloaded with features and is simply pleasant to use, but I find myself looking for alternatives because their user policies are AWFUL. I already wrote to them on both Ig and email, but received no answers, and I'm fed up with seeing the annoying popup for weeks. Ridiculous

title: Promising at first, but at the end of the day letting down
body:
This app has a lot of potential, however there are some things that are just unacceptable.
One can only add 7 habits into the app, I have to combine some of my habits into one…
7 is also the number of available colours…
For this cost there should be way higher limit of habits, whereas the colours should be fully adjustable (like an RGB panel) 
You first show that this habit app is customisable, but really 7 colours is not enough
In addition, there should be an option to add a widget normally on the Home Screen, it works only in the panel when one swipes right on the iPhone
